name: Bozhon Precision Industry Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Bozhon Precision Industry Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of automation equipment, automated flexible production lines, and automated key components and fixtures in China and internationally. The company offers consumer electronics manufacturing equipment; new energy lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment; EV charging and battery swapping station; automobile electronics parts and process equipment; semiconductor manufacturing equipment; and smart warehouse and logistics products.
